你是一名精通 IEC 61131-3 结构化文本（ST）的 PLC 工程师，正在为工业自动化控制场景编写功能块。

硬性要求：
1. 只输出**一个** ```st 代码块，代码块外不要写任何解释。
2. 必须实现题目指定的功能块名与完整接口声明（VAR_INPUT / VAR_OUTPUT / VAR_IN_OUT / VAR），
   变量名、类型、方向与题目接口表**逐个一致**，不得增删、不得改名、不得改类型。
3. 所有中间变量必须在 VAR 区显式声明；不得使用未声明的变量。
4. VAR_INPUT 在功能块内部只读，需要写入的形参必须用 VAR_IN_OUT。
5. 代码要能在真实 PLC 上编译：每个 IF / FOR / CASE / WHILE 都要正确闭合，
   END_FUNCTION_BLOCK 结尾。
6. 不要用注释掉的代码"占位"，不要留 TODO。
7. 目标为 CODESYS 3.5 / OpenPLC 的 IEC ST：END_VAR 后直接写语句，不使用 BEGIN，不使用 METHOD / ACTION / PROPERTY、指针或外部库。
8. 返回简洁的完整实现；不附测试程序或重复实现。复位的边沿/电平语义和故障优先级严格按每题要求：仅在题面明确要求上升沿时检测边沿；题面要求电平复位时，每个有效扫描都执行复位。不要将某一题的复位约定套用到其它题。
仅输出完整 FUNCTION_BLOCK FB 及必要 TYPE。不要使用 METHOD、ACTION、PROPERTY、指针或外部定时器。变量避免 s、r、dt、if 等保留名；位移采用 SHL/SHR 函数。数组上下界和类型转换须显式检查。

# 任务：Material Proportioning Process Control ## 需求 Design a PLC program to control a material proportioning process that requires mixing three types of materials according to specific requirements and then delivering them to the next process through valve D. The system needs to support both manual and automatic operation modes and be able to safely stop all equipment when an emergency stop signal is triggered. Control requirements: Emergency Stop Logic: The estop(=FALSE) signal is used for emergency stopping of all equipment. Manual Mode: opeMode=false, manually control the start/stop of valves A, B, C, D, and the mixing motor. Automatic Mode: opeMode=true, equipment operates automatically according to the process flow. Implement the emergency stop logic to ensure that all equipment stops immediately when the emergency stop signal is triggered. In manual mode, manually control the start/stop of valves and the mixing motor. For example, pressing the valve A start button valveAStart (triggering a rising edge) causes valve A to run (valveARun=TRUE); pressing the valve A start button valveAStart again (triggering a rising edge) stops valve A (valveARun=FALSE). In automatic mode, implement the following control logic based on the process flow: Press the autoStart button to start the automatic process, first opening valve A. When the liquid level sensor levelSensor reaches 50cm, close valve A and open valve B. When the liquid level sensor reaches 80cm, close valve B. Based on processMode: If processMode=false, start the mixing motor; after receiving the mixing complete signal, stop the mixing motor, open valve D, and the automatic process ends. If processMode=true, open valve C; when the liquid level sensor reaches 100cm, close valve C, start the mixing motor; after receiving the mixing complete signal, stop the mixing motor, open valve D, and the automatic process ends. ## 接口定义（必须逐字实现，不得改动） 功能块名：`FB`（FUNCTION_BLOCK FB） | 变量名 | 类型 | 方向 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | estop | BOOL | INPUT | Emergency Stop Signal
FALSE: Emergency stop triggered
TRUE: No emergency stop triggered | | opeMode | BOOL | INPUT | Operation Mode
FALSE: Manual Operation Mode
TRUE: Automatic Operation Mode | | valveAStart | BOOL | INPUT | Valve A Start Button | | valveBStart | BOOL | INPUT | Valve B Start Button | | valveCStart | BOOL | INPUT | Valve C Start Button | | valveDStart | BOOL | INPUT | Valve D Start Button | | mixMotorStart | BOOL | INPUT | Mixing Motor Start Button | | autoStart | BOOL | INPUT | Automatic Start Button | | processMode | BOOL | INPUT | Process Mode | | levelSensor | INT | INPUT | Liquid Level Sensor (unit cm) | | mixMotorComplete | BOOL | INPUT | Mixing Complete Signal | | valveARun | BOOL | OUTPUT | Valve A Run Command | | valveBRun | BOOL | OUTPUT | Valve B Run Command | | valveCRun | BOOL | OUTPUT | Valve C Run Command | | valveDRun | BOOL | OUTPUT | Valve D Run Command | | mixMotorRun | BOOL | OUTPUT | Mixing Motor Run Command | ## 必须满足的形式化性质 - [S1] 当急停触发（estop=FALSE）时，阀 A/B/C/D 与混合电机必须全部停止 LTL: `G(estop = FALSE -> (valveARun = FALSE AND valveBRun = FALSE AND valveCRun = FALSE AND valveDRun = FALSE AND mixMotorRun = FALSE))` - [S2] 自动模式下阀 A、B、C 两两不得同时运行（进料同一时刻只有一个） LTL: `G(opeMode = TRUE -> (NOT (valveARun = TRUE AND valveBRun = TRUE) AND NOT (valveARun = TRUE AND valveCRun = TRUE) AND NOT (valveBRun = TRUE AND valveCRun = TRUE)))` - [S3] 自动模式下阀 D 运行时，阀 A/B/C 与混合电机必须停止（出料与前序设备互斥） LTL: `G(opeMode = TRUE AND valveDRun = TRUE -> (valveARun = FALSE AND valveBRun = FALSE AND valveCRun = FALSE AND mixMotorRun = FALSE))` - [S4] 自动模式下混合电机运行时，阀 A/B/C 必须关闭 LTL: `G(opeMode = TRUE AND mixMotorRun = TRUE -> (valveARun = FALSE AND valveBRun = FALSE AND valveCRun = FALSE))` - [S5] 自动模式下混合完成信号的上升沿必须使混合电机停止并打开阀 D LTL: `G(rising(mixMotorComplete) AND opeMode = TRUE AND mixMotorRun = TRUE -> (mixMotorRun = FALSE AND valveDRun = TRUE))` - [S6] 手动按钮的边沿翻转记忆、换模式与急停时的复位、自动步序的推进顺序：由用例验证的时序/数据性质 - [N10-S5] 11.10补充：上一拍处于自动搅拌，本拍仍为自动且无急停时，完成信号有效则当拍停电机并开 D 阀。 LTL: `G(prev(opeMode) AND prev(mixMotorRun) AND opeMode AND estop AND mixMotorComplete -> (NOT mixMotorRun AND valveDRun))` - [N10-S8] 11.10补充：自动模式空闲时，启动沿首先开启 A 阀。 LTL: `G(((opeMode AND estop AND rising(autoStart) AND (NOT prev(opeMode) OR prev((NOT valveARun AND NOT valveBRun AND NOT valveCRun AND NOT valveDRun AND NOT mixMotorRun)))) -> valveARun))` - [N10-S9] 11.10补充：自动A 转 B：上拍原设备已开，液位小于 50 时保持，达到阈值时切换。 LTL: `G((((estop AND opeMode AND prev(opeMode)) AND prev(valveARun)) -> ((levelSensor < 50 -> valveARun) AND (levelSensor >= 50 -> (NOT valveARun AND valveBRun)))))` - [N10-S10] 11.10补充：自动B 转 C 或混合：上拍原设备已开，液位小于 80 时保持，达到阈值时切换。 LTL: `G((((estop AND opeMode AND prev(opeMode)) AND prev(valveBRun)) -> ((levelSensor < 80 -> valveBRun) AND (levelSensor >= 80 -> (NOT valveBRun AND ((valveCRun <-> processMode) AND (mixMotorRun <-> NOT processMode)))))))` - [N10-S11] 11.10补充：自动C 转混合：上拍原设备已开，液位小于 100 时保持，达到阈值时切换。 LTL: `G((((estop AND opeMode AND prev(opeMode)) AND prev(valveCRun)) -> ((levelSensor < 100 -> valveCRun) AND (levelSensor >= 100 -> (NOT valveCRun AND mixMotorRun)))))` - [N10-S12] 11.10补充：自动混合中，完成信号到来以前保持混合。 LTL: `G((((estop AND opeMode AND prev(opeMode)) AND prev(mixMotorRun) AND NOT mixMotorComplete) -> mixMotorRun))` - [N10-S7] 11.10补充：从上电或连续急停已解除的手动拍开始，五个按钮分别只在上升沿翻转对应输出。 LTL: `G(((estop AND NOT opeMode AND (NOT prev(TRUE) OR prev(estop AND NOT opeMode))) -> ((valveARun <-> NOT (rising(valveAStart) <-> prev(valveARun))) AND (valveBRun <-> NOT (rising(valveBStart) <-> prev(valveBRun))) AND (valveCRun <-> NOT (rising(valveCStart) <-> prev(valveCRun))) AND (valveDRun <-> NOT (rising(valveDStart) <-> prev(valveDRun))) AND (mixMotorRun <-> NOT (rising(mixMotorStart) <-> prev(mixMotorRun))))))` - [N10-S13] 11.10补充：上电或处于自动空闲时，没有新启动沿应保持五路设备全停。 LTL: `G((opeMode AND estop AND (NOT prev(opeMode) OR prev((NOT valveARun AND NOT valveBRun AND NOT valveCRun AND NOT valveDRun AND NOT mixMotorRun))) AND NOT rising(autoStart)) -> (NOT valveARun AND NOT valveBRun AND NOT valveCRun AND NOT valveDRun AND NOT mixMotorRun))` - [N10-S14] 11.10补充：上电起的前四拍中，从未发出自动或手动启动信号时，不得因模式切换、急停或解除而凭空启动设备。 LTL: `G((NOT prev(prev(prev(prev(TRUE)))) AND NOT (valveAStart OR valveBStart OR valveCStart OR valveDStart OR mixMotorStart OR autoStart) AND NOT prev((valveAStart OR valveBStart OR valveCStart OR valveDStart OR mixMotorStart OR autoStart)) AND NOT prev(prev((valveAStart OR valveBStart OR valveCStart OR valveDStart OR mixMotorStart OR autoStart))) AND NOT prev(prev(prev((valveAStart OR valveBStart OR valveCStart OR valveDStart OR mixMotorStart OR autoStart))))) -> (NOT valveARun AND NOT valveBRun AND NOT valveCRun AND NOT valveDRun AND NOT mixMotorRun))` ## 补充说明 - 功能块在**每个扫描周期**被调用一次，输出在周期结束时被采样。 - 不要假设任何隐藏的定时器或全局变量；需要跨周期记住的状态请用 VAR 区静态变量。 请直接给出完整的 ```st 代码块。 实现检查清单：接口匹配；复位/安全优先；状态保持；边沿先计算再更新历史；数组边界；扫描周期。
